one_layer.rule: not (a layer-0 head with prev >= 0.5 and a layer-0 head with ind >= 0.5)

formation_at_every_size.rule: n_formed >= ceil(18 n / 20) at every size

DECISIONS: m = tanh(log-odds / 2) of the stored float64 log-odds (= 2p - 1 of the p the runner stored as log-odds), clipped to +-(1 - 1e-12) pattern by pattern before any averaging. The runner's probe counts are not used.

C_U: CellStats over all H heads in head order (one cell per pattern: count 1, sum m), positions = the set. M_U: CellStats over the set's heads, each cell holding the 2^(H-k) patterns that agree on them (count = their number, sum = their sum of m), so the cell mean is the plain average of m over the other heads, in probability space. Both with weights='uniform'. The stored pmf_U is checked to be exactly uniform (stage-1 check) and is otherwise not needed.

Sets: all sets of 1-3 heads in itertools.combinations order (head j = layer * n_head + head), at every pattern checkpoint, both references, theta and both eta values; stored in the stage-1 cache and reported per run at the last checkpoint (runs[].last_checkpoint_values). Only the pairs enter B3, M, onsets and trajectories.

Ties (§1, values within 1e-12 nats): two measure values a, b are tied when |a - b| <= 1e-12. This is used in the AUC (ties count one half), in the rank of the best composition pair (larger by more than 1e-12) and in the onsets ("exceeds tau" = value - tau > 1e-12: strictly greater, and a value tied with tau does not exceed it). Attention scores and losses are compared exactly (>= 0.5, >= 0.15, <= 0.1, <= 1.0, >= 4.0).

Roles use the light curve's last row (x_prev_l0h*, x_prev2_l0h*, x_ind_l1h*: the scores of tycho.tasks.induction on the probe set), which is the last pattern checkpoint (checked: the light-curve and pattern step grids are equal). Layer-0 heads are previous-token (prev >= 0.5), else context (prev2 >= 0.15), else role-less; layer-1 heads are induction (ind >= 0.5), else role-less. The 1-layer controls get the layer-0 rules only (reported, used nowhere).
Repeat loss = the light-curve key x_loss_rep. Formation (main runs only) uses the last row; M eligibility = formed and at least one role-less head (a context head is not role-less).

Pair kinds: composition = (previous-token, induction); redundancy = two previous-token or two induction heads; 'pairs with a context head' (B3, trajectories) = every pair containing a context head, whatever the other head; 'remaining' = the rest (each has a role-less head). Referee (i): positives = circuit pairs, negatives = every other pair. Referee (ii): negatives = pairs with at least one role-less head; pairs of previous-token, induction and context heads with at least one context head are left out.

IC-1: configuration group = (region, d_model) (7 groups in the run). One done object per group, drawn with numpy default_rng(20261116).choice over the objects sorted by id, groups taken in sorted order. Each is replayed with tycho.train.run_object (spec rebuilt from the manifest record and the region's train settings in configs/sky_v2b.yaml, object id checked; RIConfig from the region's ri with enabled = True; torch with one thread) and compared bit for bit (dtype, shape and bytes) on every light-curve key except wall_s and on every array of the patterns file (steps, logodds, counts, pmf_*, input_names, n_probe and all param/... arrays). A failed or skipped IC-1, or a failed stage 1, withholds the verdicts of B1, B2 and M (status.withheld_because), as in Part A; all numbers are still computed.
IC-2 on the done controls, last light-curve row. 1-layer runs: the largest layer-0 prev score and the largest layer-0 ind score are compared with 0.5 (the two may come from the same head).
Phase-change step: the first light-curve evaluation (step 0 included) with x_loss_rep <= 1.0.

Formation rate per size = formed / main objects of that size in the manifest (objects not done count as not formed; the rate over done objects is also given). The prediction 'at least 18 of 20 seeds at every size' is evaluated as n_formed >= ceil(18 n / 20), n = main objects of the size (18 when n = 20), at every size present.

Joint-seed resampling (B1 and M): the seed labels are the sorted distinct seeds of the main objects in the manifest. Each resample is one call rng.integers(0, n_labels, size=n_labels) of a numpy default_rng(20261116); a resample that breaks the redraw rule is discarded and the next draw from the same stream is used, until B resamples are kept. B1 and M each use their own stream started from the seed. A label drawn k times contributes its run at every size with weight k; skipped runs contribute nothing. If the observed data cannot satisfy the redraw rule the bootstrap is not run (NaN).

B1 slope: ordinary least squares of ln(phase-change step) on ln(d_model), one point per formed main run; in a resample, the same with the multiplicities as weights. Interval: numpy percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 (method 'linear') of the B slopes; 'entirely below 0' = upper bound < 0.

B2: for each formed run, the first light-curve evaluation at which the largest layer-1 ind score is >= 0.5 and the first at which the largest layer-0 prev score is >= 0.5; "before" = strictly earlier evaluation. The prediction (>= 80 %, inclusive) is scored on the share pooled over all formed runs; shares per size are given.

M: per-run AUCs are computed (last checkpoint) for every formed run where defined; only eligible runs of the family sizes enter Delta. Family sizes: main sizes with at least --min-eligible (pre-registered 10) eligible runs (one run per seed and size). The family, the eligible runs and the bootstrap resamples are the same for both referees and for the composition-only secondary.

M: Delta favours theta when > 0 and eta when < 0 (0 favours neither). A (referee, eta value) combination is met for a view at a reference when Delta favours that view, |Delta| >= 0.05 and the Holm p < 0.05. A Delta that cannot be computed (no family size) gets p = 1 in Holm and is never met. The bootstrap CI (2.5, 97.5 %) of Delta is also reported.

M labels, per reference and view: 'ahead' = all four combinations met; 'referee-dependent' = the met combinations lie under exactly one referee; 'value-dependent' = they use exactly one eta value (a single met combination is both); 'partial' = met combinations span both referees and both eta values without being all four (three combinations, or (i, bounded) with (ii, Gaussian), or (i, Gaussian) with (ii, bounded)): the pre-registration's amendment of 16 November 2026. None but 'ahead' counts as ahead.

Secondary, composition pairs only: positives = composition pairs, redundancy pairs dropped, negatives as under each referee; the same Delta, bootstrap (same resamples), Holm, labels and outcome, reported apart. Rank of the best composition pair: per formed run, view and reference at the last checkpoint, 1 + the number of the 15 pairs whose value exceeds the best composition value by more than 1e-12; summarised over the eligible runs of the family sizes and over all formed runs.

Onsets: per main run, view (theta, eta bounded, eta Gaussian) and reference, the largest of the 15 pair values at each pattern checkpoint; onset = the first checkpoint with step >= 1 whose value exceeds tau (see ties). tau = numpy.percentile(pool, 99, method="linear"), pool = for every control run of the configuration, the largest pair value at each checkpoint with step >= 1, pooled. (a) the no-repeat runs of the same size (no tau, and no onset, for a size without them); (b) the 1-layer runs (3 pairs), one tau for every size; (c) 0.001. Lead = checkpoint index of the phase change - checkpoint index of the onset on the shared grid (> 0: onset earlier).

B3: per main run, view and reference at the last checkpoint, share = sum over the kind's pairs / sum over all 15 pairs (NaN if that sum is 0); kinds composition, redundancy, pairs with a context head, remaining. Trajectories: per run and checkpoint the mean over the kind's pairs (composition, redundancy, pairs with a context head). §5 lists every done main run; its summaries (by size, and B3 also over all sizes: mean of per-run shares and the pooled share) use the formed runs, and the trajectories the formed runs with at least one pair of the kind on the size's common grid.

Withheld or not evaluable (added after the independent verification of the code): the B1, B2 and M verdicts are withheld when IC-1 is skipped or fails, when stage 1 fails for any done object (a missing light curve or stage-1 cache counts as a stage-1 failure), or when a data check fails (71 checkpoints, equal pattern and light-curve grids, finite values, uniform pmf_U, head names); all numbers are still computed. IC-2 with no control run, B1's slope prediction when the slope or its interval cannot be computed, and M when no size has enough eligible seeds are reported as not evaluable, not as passed, not met or tie.
